cpc_usd.method: published benchmarks: low/high = range of the industry and sub-industry median CPCs listed in 'figures'; median = most specific benchmark

competition.method: proxy: benchmark median CPC tier (>= $8 high, $4-7.99 medium, < $4 low; rule from the CPC research)

seasonality.note: No seasonality data in the research sources for this keyword.

ai_query.text: No per-keyword AI query share is published. Context: 45% of US consumers used AI tools for local business recommendations in 2026; 75% of observed ChatGPT local-service sessions used keyword-style prompts such as '[service] in [city]'; ChatGPT ran a web search on 59% of local-intent prompts vs 31% overall.

figures.label: US adults using AI for local recommendations
local-intent prompts that triggered web search

registry_competitors.method: count of registry listings tagged with the keyword (city/national) or with the base service in the same state (state keywords)

market.agent_demand_note: Not yet measured. Will carry AI-agent query counts from the registry's agent analytics (contract: meta.agent_demand_contract in the market index).

equivalent_google_ads_cost_month.estimate_method: estimate: monthly searches (local value for city/state keywords, US value for national) x industry search-ad CTR (WordStream 2025) x CPC basis (cpc.basis_for_value); rounded to 2 significant figures. Approximate monthly cost of buying the ad clicks these searchers make on Google Ads; not a quote.

search_value_index.estimate_method: estimate: search value index = monthly searches x CPC basis; an advertiser-value ranking signal, not revenue; rounded to 2 significant figures.

auction.pricing_rule: tier minimum (premium $500, high $250, mid $100, standard $50) for national keywords; city = max($10, 20% of tier); state = max($10, 35% of tier); spots 2-4 open at 10% of the featured minimum
auction.model: Monthly auction in the last 7 days of each month: days 1-5 bid for the Featured #1 spot, days 6-7 for spots 2-4; winners display all next month; all paid spots labeled Sponsored.
